description: Inspect repository status before planning changes, when the task concerns this repository
Discover tracked source files as concrete read actions when repository exploration is useful
command: git ls-files -z | python3 -c 'import sys,json,shlex; names=sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode().split(chr(0)); print(json.dumps([{"description":"Read "+p,"command":"head -n 100 -- "+shlex.quote(p)} for p in names if p and p.endswith((".c",".h",".py",".md"))][:24]))'
